context.passage:
From: | | Ziana Zhao <zzhao@ muraseglobaltech.com>
To: | | Kal Rudra <krudra@muraseglobaltech.com>
Subject: | | First contact
Date: | [ 15 August
Dear Mr. Rudra:
As you may know, Sonia Lobo is starting in the sales department next week. It is our
policy to partner new employees with a “first contact’”—a staff member who, like you, has
been with the company for more than five years. Your supervisor, who highly regards your
positive attitude and your ability to work effectively within a team environment, has
recommended you to be Sonia’s first contact.
If you are willing to help out, your responsibilities during Sonia’s first week would be to
show her around the office, introduce her to your colleagues, answer her questions, and
help her get accustomed to our office culture. Afterwards, we expect that Sonia will be
sufficiently settled into her duties to need assistance only as questions arise.
Please let me know if you are interested in and available for this assignment.
Sincerely,
Ziana Zhao
Human Resources Assistant
Murase Global Tech
